previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: One cleanup exception skips remaining cleanup and masks the original native failure
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: Any controller/reaper/native closure/fixture closure/detach operation raises; sys.settrace fails after threading.settrace succeeds; a foreign stdio owner replaces one binding.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: The producer finally performs cleanup sequentially without protected per-stage funnels. An early failure skips fixture close and observer detach and replaces primary_exception. Observer install has no rollback after partially setting hooks. Fixture stdio restoration also overwrites all three globals after detecting foreign replacement instead of restoring only still-owned bindings.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Use ordered independently protected cleanup stages with exact stage errors/unknowns and preservation of the original exception. Roll back only hooks actually installed by this observer after partial install. Restore each still-owned stdio/hook independently; never overwrite a foreign replacement or claim restoration when ownership is lost.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Actual exception/ownership funnel in selected Source; no injected failure or hook mutation was executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Ordered per-stage protected cleanup preserves primary native exception; later stage errors retained; observer partial install rolls back only installed still-owned hooks; stdio restores each still-owned binding without replacing foreign bindings.
